method: Requested every configured zoom level, decoded the response as an image, and checked for non-uniform visible content. Transparent overlays may be blank when no feature crosses the sampled tile.

package_selection.rule: Include sources with confirmed useful Taiwan content. Exclude sources that are region-specific outside Taiwan, could not display at the Taichung sample, or require an API key for a non-Taiwan service.
